content: tikv-jemallocator 0.7.0 (2026-05-25), edition 2018, no MSRV declared, MIT/Apache-2.0, depends on tikv-jemalloc-sys 0.7.0. jemalloc supports darwin arm64 but the build is heavier and macOS track record weaker than mimalloc; same CLI-only global-allocator feature rule applies. Not the first choice for rustkmer; skip unless mimalloc underperforms in profiling.
